title: God of War: Chains of Olympus

info.about: God of War: Chains of Olympus is a 2008 action-adventure game developed by Ready at Dawn, and published by Sony Computer Entertainment (SCE). It was first released for the PlayStation Portable (PSP) handheld console on March 4, 2008.
info.trivia: Ready at Dawn's prequel was the handheld's technical showpiece.
info.why: Common, and included in an HD collection on PS3, so prices are low.
